verdict.rationale: USPTO's own site addresses non-lawyer filers in plain language. It claims to "guide you through every step of the application process" (uspto-docs-36), offers a quick IP-eligibility assessment (uspto-docs-37) and a "File a patent application on your own" path (uspto-docs-30), explains trademark application stages and wait times (uspto-docs-31, -32, -33), and gives plain pre-filing advice to search first (uspto-docs-34, -35). However, the pack shows mostly headline claims and link titles rather than the step-by-step explainers themselves. Missing for 10: the actual content of step-by-step walkthroughs for a founder's task, evidence of their depth and readability, and independent or hands-on confirmation that non-lawyers can follow them.
